title: Bikewatching
description: Mapbox · D3. An interactive map of about 260,000 Bluebikes rides in Boston and Cambridge from March 2024. Circle size shows traffic at each station, color shows whether riders mostly leave or arrive, and a time slider filters trips by hour of day.

title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: Using World Bank unemployment data for 187 countries, we built two honest charts that argue opposite sides of whether youth unemployment is disproportionately high, then explored where persuasion ends and deception begins.

title: Ocean Pulse: Ocean Health Classification Dashboard
description: Python · DataHacks 2026, 3rd place out of 86 teams (ML/AI track). Trained a Random Forest on 286,819 CalCOFI samples (98% accuracy) to classify ocean regions as Healthy, Stressed, or Critical, and built a Streamlit dashboard with LLM-powered, region-specific policy recommendations.

title: Predicting NBA Success from NCAA Performance Metrics
description: Python · Pandas · Regression. Merged 3 data sources into a dataset of 386 drafted players and built an OLS regression model; college Box Plus-Minus was the strongest predictor of NBA impact (β = 0.40, p < 0.001).

title: Image and Audio Processing App
description: Python. Implemented grayscale, rotation, edge detection, and audio effects from scratch, plus a KNN classifier for RGB images with 90% label accuracy and no external ML libraries.
